findings.finding: Readable seed/branch/old-baseline legends, temperature and percentage units, chronological redshift direction and identical comparison-grid scope; separate Planck-reference limitation explicit.

The narrow CI continuation hatch corresponds to a small contribution. Gas audit curves and separate Simpson endpoint markers are clearly labelled.

Branch/refinement/sum series and log axes are readable. Stress excludes shear explicitly; finite empirical comparison is distinguished from a global bound. Values agree with independently reviewed branch-resolution outcome.
